    Specializing simultaneous subspaces of a matrix family #

    source
    def EFiniteCharacterizations.HasMatrixSubspacePair {L : Type u_3} [Field L] {a : Type u_4} {n : Type u_5} {m : Type u_6} [Fintype n] [Fintype m] (D : a → Matrix m n L) (r s : ℕ) :
    Prop

    Columns of two split injections specify subspaces of the stated dimensions. The intertwining equations say all the matrices send the first subspace into the second.
